source: NHTSA Vehicle Crash Test Database (public domain, US government)
summary: 2014.5 Toyota Camry 4-door (VIN 4T1BF1FK5EU355764), NCAP full-frontal into a 36-load-cell rigid wall at 56.71 km/h, Calspan, 2014-02-24. Test mass 1664 kg (curb 1460). 14 high-speed films at 1000 fps, T0 = file frame 50 (first contact checked in camera 3 at frames 50 and 52 and by the door targets' travel against the sensor curve: 0.30, 0.43, 0.53, 0.62, 0.65 m at 20, 30, 40, 55, 70 ms against 0.296, 0.423, 0.528, 0.632, 0.663 m). Sequence: fascia and bumper at 0-10 ms; hood buckles from 15-20 ms into a tent by 30 ms (first wall-force peak, 916 kN at 29 ms); front hub stops at about 45 ms and the wheel is pushed back 113 mm relative to the door by 65 ms (second peak 628 kN at 53 ms); maximum travel 0.66 m at 71 ms; rebound 1.5 m/s (sensor), separation 121 ms (report); rear pitches up 3-4 degrees nose down at 100-150 ms. Post-test (report): crush C1..C6 445, 494, 529, 523, 468, 409 mm; maximum 554 mm at the centreline; wheelbase -66 mm left, -30 mm right; doors close and open. Comparison with Rubble: engine/docs/crash-reference/camry-frontal-comparison.md.
sources: report v08545R001.pdf (Calspan TR2685, 220 pages): PDF p. 10 (Data Sheet 1 cont., p. 2-4): weights (UVW 1460 kg, ATW 1664 kg, front/rear 868/796 kg as tested), CG 1325 mm aft of front axle as tested, wheelbase 2769 mm, lengths
PDF p. 18 (Data Sheet 6, p. 2-12): camera table: cameras 2-15 at 1000 fps, camera 1 real time 60 fps, positions and lenses
PDF p. 26 (Data Sheet 13, p. 2-20): impact 56.71 km/h, velocity change 56.71 km/h, time of separation 121 ms, crush profile C1-C6, damage width 1055 mm
PDF p. 27 (Data Sheet 14, p. 2-21): wheelbase pre/post 2769 -> 2703 left, 2739 right; door openings unchanged
PDF p. 3 (abstract) and p. 6 (p. 2-1): maximum static crush 554 mm at the centreline
sensor curves: engine/docs/crash-reference/nhtsa/8545.json (nhtsa_reference.py: rear-seat crossmember X, CFC 60; load-cell sum)
contact sheets and frames: nhtsa_footage.py --sheets, camry_frontal.py strip/stills (local only)
